### Comment
> I've isolated a bug where domains confirmed as blocked by my active filter lists are still resolving live and serving content through my account's DNS servers. I've ruled out every variable on my end and would appreciate help checking server-side.
> 
> **Account/servers affected:**
> - DNS addresses: `94.140.14.49` / `94.140.14.59` (IPv4), `2a10:50c0::ded:ff` / `2a10:50c0::dad:ff` (IPv6)
> - Device profile: TP-Link Deco M5
> 
> **The issue:**
> `doubleclick.net` and `m.doubleclick.net` both show as **blocked** in your own "Check a domain" tool for this device:
> - `doubleclick.net` → blocked by **AdGuard DNS filter**, rule `||doubleclick.net^`
> - `m.doubleclick.net` → blocked by **OISD Blocklist Big**, rule `||m.doubleclick.net^`
> 
> But live queries to your resolvers return real answers for both, not a block:
> 
> ```
> nslookup doubleclick.net 94.140.14.49
> Server:  94-140-14-49.adguard-dns.com
> Address:  94.140.14.49
> 
> Non-authoritative answer:
> Name:    doubleclick.net
> Addresses:  2607:f8b0:4007:806::200e
>             142.251.41.14
> ```
> 
> **Live example — ad served from a blocked domain:**
> While browsing imdb.com, a banner ad loaded successfully via a request to `ad.doubleclick.net`, captured in my browser's Network tab:
> ```
> https://ad.doubleclick.net/ddm/adj/N805.2646AMAZONMEDIAGROUPLLC./B34608755.433941313;dc_ver=107.317;...
> ```
> Status: **200** (completed successfully)
> 
> This confirms the mismatch isn't limited to isolated `nslookup` testing — the domain is actively resolving and serving ad content in real browsing sessions despite being confirmed blocked.
> 
> **What I've ruled out:**
> - Local DNS cache — flushed repeatedly, no change
> - My own custom User Rules — tested with the toggle both on and off, no difference
> - My whitelist/custom filtering rules — checked for any rule referencing "doubleclick," none found
> - My router (TP-Link Deco M5, HomeShield security features disabled) and my ISP gateway (AT&T, IP Passthrough mode, Firewall Advanced settings all off) — ruled out by tethering a laptop to cellular data and querying `94.140.14.49` directly by IP, bypassing all home network equipment entirely. Same result: not blocked.
> - The Query Log shows no entry — blocked or otherwise — for queries to the bare `doubleclick.net` domain, even though live queries clearly reached your server and got an answer.
> 
> I would appreciate help figuring out why these ads are still not being blocked. 
> 
> Thanks,
> Josh
